argv:
main=$(pidof dev.vibevoice.podcast.internal 2>/dev/null); code=$?
[ "$code" = 0 ] || [ "$code" = 1 ] || exit 51
if [ -z "$main" ]; then printf 'APP_MAIN_ABSENT\n'; exit 0; fi
uid=$(cmd package list packages -U dev.vibevoice.podcast.internal | awk '$1 == "package:dev.vibevoice.podcast.internal" { sub("uid:","",$2); print $2 }')
case "$uid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) printf 'APP_AUDIO_UNKNOWN_UID\n'; exit 52;; esac
audio=$(dumpsys audio) || exit 53
printf '%s\n' "$audio" | awk -v uid="$uid" '
BEGIN { monitor=0; schema=0; own=0; active=0; unknown=0 }
{ line=tolower($0)
 if (line ~ /playbackactivitymonitor/) monitor=1
 if (line ~ /u\/pid:|uid\/pid:/) schema=1
 if (line ~ ("u/id:" uid "/")) unknown++
 if (line ~ ("u/pid:[[:space:]]*" uid "/") || line ~ ("uid/pid:[[:space:]]*" uid "/")) {
   own++
   if (line ~ /state:[[:space:]]*(started|starting)/) active++
   else if (line !~ /state:[[:space:]]*(paused|stopped|released|idle)/) unknown++
 }
}
END { printf "APP_AUDIO_MONITOR %d SCHEMA %d OWN %d ACTIVE %d UNKNOWN %d\n",monitor,schema,own,active,unknown;
 if (!monitor || !schema || active || unknown) exit 54 }
'
